title: UK government appoints Dr Rachel Emma-Jane Fentem as ambassador to the Republic of Korea
excerpt: Dr Fentem will succeed Mr Colin James Crooks in March 2027 as the head of the UK diplomatic mission in Seoul.
bodyHtml:
The UK government announced on October 28, 2026, that Dr Rachel Emma-Jane Fentem CMG has been appointed as His Majesty’s Ambassador to the Republic of Korea. She will succeed Mr Colin James Crooks LVO, who will be leaving the Diplomatic Service.

Dr Fentem has held various government roles since 2008, including positions at the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office, the Prime Minister’s Office, and HM Treasury. Her experience includes serving as the Principal Private Secretary to the Foreign Secretary from 2022 to 2025 and as Deputy Principal Private Secretary to the Foreign Secretary from 2021 to 2022.

She also served as a Counsellor in Berlin from 2018 to 2021 and in Tokyo from 2017 to 2018. Additionally, she worked as the Director of Overseas Operations for the Department for International Trade between 2016 and 2017, and as a Counsellor in Tokyo from 2015 to 2016. Dr Fentem will take up her appointment during March, 2027.
